info.about: Raiden III is a vertically scrolling shooter developed by MOSS and released in as an arcade video game in 2005. It is the fourth game in Seibu Kaihatsu's Raiden series; it is the first installment in the series to be developed by MOSS as it consists of former Seibu Kaihatsu employees who bought the rights to the series.
info.trivia: UFO Interactive brought the arcade shooter to the US in 2007.
info.why: A tiny late-life print run from a minor publisher makes it one of the scarcest PS2 shooters.
